title: Projects and PlantUML
summary: Organize work by project and create diagrams with a local PlantUML workspace.
notes: Create and switch projects from the sidebar or Settings.
Keep testing environments and Quick Query work separate for each project.
Write PlantUML diagrams with a live preview, workspace files, and SVG or PNG export.

slides.title: Organize work by project
slides.body: Create projects in Settings and switch between them from the sidebar.
bullets: Each project has its own testing environments and Quick Query schemas, data, and tabs.
Your existing environments and Quick Query work remain in the default project.

slides.title: Create diagrams with PlantUML
slides.body: Write diagram source and see the preview update as you edit.
bullets: Organize files and folders in a local workspace.
Import files, export a workspace ZIP, or save the diagram as SVG or PNG.

tips.title: Switch projects
tips.body: Choose a project or open project management from here.

tips.title: Search has moved
tips.body: Search tools, pages, and Quick Query schemas from the app header.

tips.title: Open PlantUML
tips.body: Select PlantUML to create and preview diagrams.
